batches.name: Repository Hygiene
batches.scope: remove generated caches and externalize rebuildable/historical payloads; never delete audit-worthy Provider evidence
batches.estimated_deletions: 1 ignored 587.8 MB ZIP plus selected generated files
batches.risk: LOW to HIGH by evidence class
batches.rollback: archive with SHA-256 and restore manifest before removal
batches.commit_strategy: one inventory commit, one archive/export commit, one deletion commit

batches.name: Test Consolidation
batches.scope: deduplicate root/integration mirrors and parameterize repeated boundary/freeze assertions
batches.estimated_deletions: 8 exact duplicate root files plus validated wrapper candidates
batches.rollback: retain compatibility wrappers for one release

batches.name: Shared Utilities
batches.scope: centralize canonical JSON, hashes, references, time/path validation, and redaction engines
batches.rollback: compatibility functions delegate to shared implementation

batches.name: Quality API Consolidation
batches.scope: converge Stage 11 into quality/assessment, quality/review, quality/corpus
batches.estimated_deletions: integration facade internals after wrapper migration
batches.rollback: retain old imports and serialized schemas
batches.commit_strategy: assessment, review, corpus, then compatibility facade

batches.name: Production Path Simplification
batches.scope: one CLI, one runtime, one prompt builder, explicit quality boundary, archive disconnected candidates
batches.estimated_deletions: legacy unreachable modules only after caller audit
batches.rollback: feature flag and old runtime facade retained until parity
batches.commit_strategy: separate API facade, adapter migration, then dead-code removal
